visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, sleek dark brown hair is framed from the chest up, positioned in a warmly lit indoor room. She smiles warmly at the camera while holding three tubes of sunscreen in shades of peach, light green, and pink. (2) The shot shifts to a close-up of the three Dewytree sunscreen tubes resting on a smooth surface, with white text overlays detailing the product names. (3) Returning to the woman, she holds a pink tube and begins to squeeze a small amount of white, creamy liquid onto the skin of her inner forearm, using her other hand to spread it evenly. (4) A split-screen visual appears, showing her two forearms side-by-side; the left arm appears naturally slightly more yellow, while the right arm, treated with the product, shows a noticeable pinkish, brightened tone. (5) In a close-up, the woman applies dots of the pink cream onto her cheek and uses her fingertips to gently blend the product into her face, which has a natural glow. (6) She takes a clean white tissue and presses it firmly against her cheek, then pulls it away to show that no residue or stickiness is left on the paper. (7) She poses with her chin resting on her hand, displaying her finished, brightened skin and smiling confidently. (8) The scene transitions to an outdoor sidewalk where the woman, now in a white crocheted top, walks while shielding her eyes from bright sunlight, showcasing her radiant skin in natural light. (9) A close-up of an arm shows swatches of the pink, skin-tone, and green products, followed by her applying the skin and green variants to different parts of her arm to show their blending effect. (10) The final scene shows the woman indoors once more holding the product, followed by a graphic screen featuring the brand name and product information against a solid light pink background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young woman's voice begins speaking in a bright and friendly tone, with very clear articulation. Underneath, a mid-tempo electronic pop BGM starts with a steady, clean synthesized drum beat. The atmosphere is professional and studio-clean. (2) As she discusses the product's ranking and brand name, a subtle 'pop' sound effect highlights the transition of on-screen text. The BGM maintains a consistent, upbeat tempo and major-mode tonality. (3) The vocal continues explaining ingredients like Vitamin B12 and cherry blossom extract. A soft 'whoosh' SFX is heard during a scene cut. The balance between voice and music is well-managed, with the voice taking prominence. (4) The narration describes the texture and application experience. No external noise from the environment is heard, despite the visuals moving between indoor and outdoor, indicating a clean studio voice-over recording. (5) The woman concludes by mentioning where to buy the product. The music continues its rhythmic loop without changing complexity, finally fading out as she delivers the brand's tagline over the logo screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for DEWYTREE's color-correcting sunscreen line. It aims to demonstrate the product's effectiveness in brightening dull skin, highlight its skincare-infused formula, and inform Taiwanese consumers about its availability at Watsons and POYA.
